text: [excited] This Christmas market looked magical online. In real life? Buckets.
The ads showed fairy lights, snowy stalls and happy crowds.
Traders were promised over fifty stalls, and twenty-five hundred visitors a day.
[curious] One visitor counted... about five stalls.
[deadpan] And buckets, catching drips from the leaky roof.
Four days after opening, every booking was cancelled.
[sighs] The organiser called it... a lesson learned.
[playfully] Would you trust an AI poster? Send this to a friend who books online.
